candidate.answerReason: Expansion and rearrangement give \(2x^2+x-3=0\). The quadratic formula then gives \(x=(-1\pm5)/4\), yielding \(1\) and \(-3/2\).

methods.label: Expand and use the quadratic formula
methods.explanation: Expanding gives \(2x²+x-1=2\), which rearranges to \(2x²+x-3=0\). Then \(b²-4ac=1+24=25\) and \(x=(-1\pm5)/4\), so \(x=1\) or \(x=-3/2\).
